description: Pool file operations. action: 'rename' renames the real file on disk (needs newName; clips referencing the old name go offline). 'delete' UNLINKS the file from the media pool — the real file on disk is NOT touched; clips using it go offline until it is added again.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: organize_media
title: Rename or unlink media
